where: cargo build of blaze (the measuring binary)
what: A cargo build prints several hundred `cargo::missing_lints_inheritance` and rustc warnings (291 in blaze-cargo alone) before any error; a filter for `^error` with context was drowned and reported a failed build as having no error.
cause: the tree is linted by blaze, so cargo's own warnings are nobody's
workaround: `RUSTFLAGS="--cap-lints allow"` and grep `^error` in the kept log
